note: Treed campground in a bend of the Souris River at Roche Percee (~20 km E of Estevan), kept up by local volunteers; large, private sites with picnic tables and fire pits, firewood sold, walking trails. A rail line runs close by. Not the La Roche Percee provincial historic site. --Claude
summary: Keep. Tourism SK listing (13 non-electric sites, $20 listed, season May long weekend-Labour Day) + Campendium camper report dated June 2026 ($30) + Google place (no rating). Not waterfront confirmed (river ~15-20 m wide, treed buffer). Phone '' -> 306-634-8102. Pin OK.
flags: PRICE CONFLICT: the operator's Tourism SK listing says $20 a night (undated); a Campendium camper report dated 2026-06-09 says '$30 dollars per night' and $600/month. Fees written at $20 from the listing; the $30 report sits in fees.note. Either way under any gate (local campground).

OPERATOR: Tourism SK files it as a 'Municipal Campground' under the account 'South East Tours & Trails'; the 2026 camper paid 'SE Tours & Trails Inc.' by e-transfer. The old note's 'Village-run' is unconfirmed - dropped. ownership local left alone.
PHONE: '' -> '306-634-8102' (first Tourism SK number, also on Campendium; second listed 306-471-0305). Google shows 639-534-2315 instead - unexplained.
SITES: count 13 added (Tourism SK). Rig fit: 'the sites are large' (2022 camper); no posted limit.
SEASON added 05-15..09-07 ('Open May long weekend to Labour Day'); 2027 not out.

FACILITIES: vault_toilets (six portable toilets) and potable_water false ('non-potable water'; the 2026 camper drove to Estevan for drinking water) confirmed. Tourism SK ticks 'Sewage disposal' while a 2022 camper calls it 'zero services' - dump left absent.
BOOKING: no reservation channel; reservable false, fcfs always, platform none (method reported - from the listing's silence plus the camper report).

NIGHTLY SHARE: weekly/monthly/seasonal rates are offered and the 2026 camper saw '1 or 2 trailers' left long-term among 13 sites - not mostly seasonal on this evidence; no Google rating to give (the Google place shows none).
PRESENCE: current - Tourism SK listing, a Facebook group, Google place, a June 2026 camper report. No village web page found (rochepercee.ca and similar don't resolve).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Esri z17: the camping area fills a meander bend of the Souris River, here ~15-20 m wide (creek-sized), with treed riparian banks; no site sits on open ground at the bank.
PIN: stored 49.0791,-102.7519 is inside the camping bend, ~25 m from open sites - OK. Google 49.07927,-102.75029 (~110 m E, also in the bend); Tourism SK point 49.07806,-102.7503 is on the river.
WEBSITE: Tourism SK listing kept; could add the Facebook group https://www.facebook.com/groups/319663558106591 (not read).
